mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, created_at, deleted_at, first_name, last_name, email, phone, organization_id) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{createdAt}, #{deletedAt}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{organizationId})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, password, created_at, deleted_at, first_name, last_name, email, phone, organization_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT user_id, username, password, created_at, deleted_at, first_name, last_name, email, phone, organization_id FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
AND organization_id = #{organizationId}
AND user_id = #{userId}
AND POSITION(LOWER(#{firstName}) IN LOWER(first_name)) > 0
AND POSITION(LOWER(#{lastName}) IN LOWER(last_name)) > 0
AND POSITION(LOWER(#{email}) IN LOWER(email)) > 0
ORDER BY last_name, first_name, user_id

SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.password, u.created_at, u.deleted_at, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.phone, u.organization_id FROM users u JOIN user_locations ul ON ul.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ul.location_id = #{locationId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ul.end_date IS NULL OR ul.end_date > NOW()) ORDER BY u.last_name, u.first_name, u.user_id

SELECT user_id, username, password, created_at, deleted_at, first_name, last_name, email, phone, organization_id FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, organization_id = #{organizationId} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
